notes: Sunwell Plateau's Sunmote upgrade path: vendor Yrma exchanges a base raid drop plus a Sunmote for the upgraded piece. Two-hop in the same sense the tier tokens are — the piece comes from a named raid boss via an intermediary — but these are NOT class tier set pieces, so they deliberately live outside data/two-hop/ret-tokens.json, which pool-hardening.test.ts pins against wowsims db setIds.
Sunmote itself is not an item in the pinned vendor/wowsims/db.json, so there is no token item id to record.

baseId is the pre-upgrade drop; all three are already admitted to ret-p5 on their own. Zones and bosses are db.json's own attribution for baseId (sources[0].drop), not the Wowhead guide's — the guide writes the Eredar Twins encounter as 'Lady Sacrolash'.
Item ids and the upgrade pairings come from the Wowhead ret P5 BiS list (data/wowhead-lists/ret/p5.json wowheadSourceText), which names the base item for each.
